title: Anthropic licenses, releases Opaque in acquihire
key_facts: Anthropic will "acquirhire" Opaque, a company specialised in confidential computing and AI.
Terms were not disclosed; Opaque CEO Aaron Fulkerson noted the deal in a post.
The structure: Anthropic licenses Opaque's technology and brings on some of the team.
Opaque had closed a $24 million Series B at a $300 million valuation and partnered with Nvidia, Intel, Microsoft and Google on confidential computing.
Opaque rolled out a security framework adopted in Europe and the UAE and recently released open standards for sovereign AI and on-premises deployments.
Constellation's view: the deal makes sense as Anthropic increasingly courts enterprises eyeing on-premises deployments, open models and sovereign AI architectures.
Fulkerson's post: "We're proud to share a new agreement with Anthropic that carries OPAQUE's work forward."
